name: Finca La Rosala Mediterranean EVOO & Rosemary Almonds
ingredients_found: Skinless Valencia almonds (94%), salt, extra virgin olive oil (1%), gum arabic (E-414), rosemary (1%), whole cane sugar, natural rosemary flavor, La Vera paprika.
reason: Added whole cane sugar (L2 sugar in a savory/staple category) plus gum arabic / E-414 (L3 added gum/emulsifier). The prior 'clean' audit omitted both ingredients.
justification: Added cane sugar in a savory staple floods the hepatic portal vein without a fibrous matrix (Principle 4, de novo lipogenesis), and added gum arabic is a surfactant gum that stresses the mucosal shield (Principle 1).
notes: Marketed as EVOO + rosemary but the real deck contains gum arabic and cane sugar; audited the Valencia rosemary/EVOO variant. Multiple independent retailer/brand listings agree on the sugar + gum.

name: Karma Nuts Sea Salt Wrapped Cashews
reason: Whole cashews with skin intact, air-roasted with no oil, only sea salt. Zero seed oils, zero sugar, zero additives.
justification: Oil-free air-roasting avoids introducing oxidized PUFA hydroperoxides (Principle 3); clean whole-food matrix with only salt. Conventional (not sprouted/single-origin) so it sits at Tier 2 rather than Tier 1.

name: Almondeli Valencia Almonds with Herbs
ingredients_found: Blanched Valencia almonds, sunflower oil, herbs (rosemary, thyme, oregano and related fine herbs), sea salt.
reason: Fried in sunflower oil (L3 industrial seed oil). The prior 'clean' audit incorrectly listed extra virgin olive oil.
justification: Deep-frying almonds in sunflower oil coats them in a thermally/solvent-degraded PUFA carrier generating cytotoxic lipid hydroperoxides (Principle 3), hard-disqualifying a savory staple.
notes: Almondeli Valencia almonds are consistently described across sources as fried in sunflower oil, not EVOO.

name: Daily Crunch Original Sprouted Almonds
reason: Single-ingredient sprouted almonds, no oil, no salt, no sugar. Sprouting is the Tier 1 defining feature.
justification: Sprouting activates endogenous phytase to pre-digest phytic acid and attenuate FODMAPs (Principle 5), reducing lower-GI bloating; a 100% clean whole-food matrix with zero disruptors earns Gold Standard.

name: Daily Crunch Nashville Hot Sprouted Almonds
ingredients_found: Sprouted Almonds, Cayenne Pepper, Smoked Paprika, Chili Powder, Onion Granules, Garlic Granules, Sea Salt, Organic Tapioca Starch, Avocado Oil, Monk Fruit Sweetener.
reason: Sprouted base seasoned with avocado oil (clean, not a seed oil), spices, tapioca starch, and monk fruit sweetener. No seed oil, no added sugar, no gums.
justification: Avocado oil is a stable MUFA carrier that avoids seed-oil hydroperoxides (Principle 3); the sprouted almond base is pre-digested (Principle 5). Pure monk-fruit extract as the only sweetener keeps it in the clean zone but the engineered seasoning matrix caps it at Tier 2.
notes: Monk fruit is listed as a single ingredient with no separately declared erythritol/inulin/gum; if the sweetener were a polyol blend it would trash. Tapioca starch is a starch, not a flagged gum.
